batting.name: KP Pietersen
batting.dismissal: st AT Rayudu b Harbhajan Singh

batting.dismissal: c JP Duminy b KA Pollard

balls.text: lovely slower ball, comes through only after he has completed the shot, gets the single
low full toss, clears the front leg, doesn't quite get hold of it, but still clears long-on. Carnage!
bouncer, outside off, beats him on the pull
full outside off, hit to third man, Pandey is done in by the spin, and the fumble is enough for them to come back for two
big wide down the leg side, and Uthappa does well to dive full length and saves four
low full toss, and they steal a second after hitting it to long-on. Wide throw from Pietersen too
full toss, thigh-high, and the outside edge goes for four past keeper. It's all happening for Mumbai
low full toss, hit to wide long-on, and he retains the strike
dot ball! dot ball! Stop the press! wide outside off, perfect yorker, goes under the bat
yorker gone wrong! low full toss outside off, and Pollard lofts it over long-off. And makes it look easy
and he flicks a yorker wide of long-on, and eases back for a second that many others would have struggled to make
slower ball, length ball, Pollard waits an extra second and monsters it over long-off. More timing here than power
slower bouncer, pulled into the ground, and they rush back for two. Very quick runners

he has agricultured this for six over long-on! Such is the power in those shoulders that the mis-hits are carrying for sixes. Steyn would have thought the slower one had done him in, but it kept sailing and sailing
back of a length, into the hips, worked away for one
slower ball, cramps him up, hit down mid-off's throat. Well bowled, time for the other KP, Kieron Pollard, to walk in
into the pads, helped away between deep fine and deep square for two
premeditates the charge and is nowhere close to this shortish ball outside off
slower ball, checks the shot, nicely guides it for one to point
Tiwary charges at him, Kumble flights it on the leg stump, and he misses and takes a leg-bye
and AK over-steps again. He is not happy, he is asking the umpire questions, Doctrove says you have got to rebowl. And it is a big no-ball, which Rayudu hits to long-on for one
mistimes this sweep, one bounce to deep square
he has flat-batted this short delivery for a straight six! What power, from outside off, and dead straight, and fast and flat
Tiwary comes down the track, Kumble bowls down the leg side, and he has hit it past short fine leg
thrown it up in the air, top edge, caught, but Doctrove has his left hand in the air. Kumble has overstepped!
charges down at him, Kumble fires in a short one, dot ball to extra cover
googly, helped away to short third man for one
angling into the pads, flicked very fine, but the short fine is almost a long stop
and the inside edge gets him four too! Slightly slower ball, Tiwary slogs and the inside edge beats both the stumps and the keeper
Power. What power. Short ball, and he has bludgeoned it past midwicket. Tiwary is turning it on
back of a length, no room, hit to long-off for one
full ball, hit to long-on for one
slower ball to start off with, 118ks, and the mis-hit clears the boundary at cow corner. Good old-fashioned slog
goes for the big heave-ho, gets the inside edge towards deep midwicket for one
full ball, gets the inside half of the bat for a single to midwicket
short and wide, cut in front of square, Pandey makes a diving save at extra cover
hit powerfully to long-on, along the ground
backs away, KP floats this one gently on leg stump, turning away, Tiwary defends
comes down the track and hits one-bounce to long-off
short, pulled away for a single to square leg
cut away to deep point

Kolhi's superb fielding creates a run-out chance, but he messes it up. Tiwary is looking for a single to long-on, but Kohli runs like a hare and makes a diving save, but goes for the stumps at non-strikers when both the batsmen are having a conference there. And Tiwary runs al the way back
first six of the innings! Sees the legbreak coming, and slog-sweeps it for a big six over square leg
driven into the ground and then to Kumble at extra cover, is sent back by Rayudu
short and wide and cut away, gets two to wide of sweeper-cover
flighted on leg, dabbed into the on side for one
short, cut away to deep point for one
flatter, pushed to midwicket for one
nicely flighted around middle and leg, defended. Uthappa says, "Big shot coming up." Nice sledge
flighted around middle and leg, nurdled for one into the leg side
Tiwary makes room, the ball pitches outside leg, turns away towards middle, he gets enough bat on it to get a single
makes room and cuts, gets a single to deep point
tossed up, but full and he gets an easy single to long-on
full and fast, hit back to the bowler
looks to cut again, too full, gets a bottom edge
low full toss, flicked away
stays back to a fullish delivery, gets a single wide of point
flighted around off, defended
short, worked away for a single
full and straight pushed to long-on

big turn again, gets a thick edge, and Kohli is very good at point. It's too far in front of him but he goes for it, and dives in front and makes sure he collects it on the half-volley and doesn't let it go past him. Acrobatic
turns across him, big turn, beats him, pitches middle and turns big time
played with the turn, soft hands, gets a single to short fine
drops and runs to cover, and makes it comfortably

over-eager Bangalore here. Hit between the bowler and straightish extra cover. Kumble and Pietersen both go for it, nearly colide, and neither man collects it cleanly. Pietersen shies at the stumps after having collected it, and ends up conceding an unnecessary overthrow. The positive for Bangalore is, the two men didn't collide
full, turning in, beats him, but they steal a leg-bye
poor shot. Quick delivery, 97ks, angled across him, and he looks to work it to the leg side from well outside off, and gets a leading edge to short cover
premeditated paddle, gets a low full toss, and helps it fine for two
pushed to long-off for one
shorter delivery, looks to cut but is hurried into the shot, and ends up playing straighter than he wants
flighted, too straight, worked around the corner for one
long hop, Rayudu rocks back and pulls it between deep square leg and deep midwicket
flighted delivery, pushed to long-on
KP gets the wicket! turn, bounce, and caught at short fine. Premeditates a sweep, the ball is not full enough, and the top edge is dying when PK dives forward to complete the catch

and boy does this turn? angling in, pitching middle and off, and turning away big time, and Uthappa is not sharp enough for it. But Dravid is, chases hard, and makes a sliding save at the edge of the boundary
ahh, gets him to play in front of his body, slower through the air, Rayudu checks the shot, it bounces in front of short cover
flighted outside off, drops and runs, Rayudu gets in through a big dive
slower, googly, Nayar misses, but it is spinning across, hence no lbw shout
Nayar is playing a little cameo that will annoy the bowling side. Moves across the stumps, brings the lbw shout in, and then dabs it with soft hands into the leg side and runs hard for two
slightly outside off, hit to long-off for one
full, straight, fast, 95.3ks, hit back to Kumble
dabbed to point for a single
full, outside off, pushed to long-off for one
slower ball, moves across and works it to square leg
short delivery that cuts in towards his chest, he plays it with soft hands and gets a single to third man
he does that again, but flicks this one squarer and gets only one
Nayar moves across, gets inside the line of a leg-side delivery, and glances it fine. Not a great delivery, but Nayar is creating his leg-stump line here by moving across
Rayudu rubs the salt in, lovely square-punch that bounces over cover-point and gets him another boundary
every over PK has produced an edge, and every time it has landed safe, this time it is a top edge on an unwieldy pull from outside off, but the edge flies to the third man boundary
back of a length, holds its line outside off, pushed to cover
bowls a fuller length, gets an inside edge, but it is safe and gets him a single to fine leg
short, into the leg side, not the best of connections on the pull, but he gets four off the glove. Too far down the leg side, was the bouncer
back of a length, into the hips, and worked away nicely, wide enough of mid-on to come back for two
comes down the pitch again, Vinay bowls a shorter one, Rayudu goes ahead with the slash, and slices it over the cover infield. The mis-hit clears the ring, only just
shot! He is not getting bogged down. Gives him the charge, gets close to a length ball, and lofts him over mid-off
back of a length, punched to point, doesn't find the gap
comes down the track, Vinay bounces him, is wided! How did the umpire judge the height of the ball vis-a-vis the batsman when it passed the stumps while the batsman was halfway down the pitch?
fuller ball, slightly outside off, presses forward and defends
another mix-up, looks to drop and run to square leg, but is sent back
back of a length, angling across him, worked away for one to midwicket
back of a length, outside off, defended to point
wide down the leg side
short and fast, cut away, one-bounce to third man

slower ball, 118ks, and the KP-Kohli combine have got a run-out here! Dhawan drops to cover, wants a single, is sent back as Pietersen is swooping on it fast. KP tries the direct-hit, hits the stumps, and they want to take a single off the ricochet. It hasn't gone too far, and Kohli runs Dhawan out by yards. Nayar's call, and Dhawan pays the price for responding to the call. Kohli is pumped: this needed a direct hit because Steyn wasn't there to collect the throw
bouncer, 142ks too quick for him, but the top edge clears midwicket, only just
shortens the length, Dhawan stays back to defend it
thrown up full, and fiercely square-driven away, over the infield
accurate inswinger, pushed to midwicket
flicked off the hips, gets a couple to square of deep fine leg
Nayar goes too far across to play this one, is beaten, and PK appeals half-heartedly. This one is angling across
another edge, and safe again! This time it lands inches short of Kallis at second slip. Inswinger troubling Dhawan here
tries the short one, goes down the leg side, and gets extra bounce that clears the keeper

overthrows! Looks to drop and run, but hasn't hit far enough of PK, and sends Nayar back. PK can run Nayar out, but misses with a wide throw, and KP from mid-on is there to collect the throw and there is nobody to back up
short, around off, pushed to point
this one goes away with the angle, Nayar pokes tentatively and is beaten

Steyn has taken SRT out in the big one! Outswinger, slightly short, slightly wider of his reach, Tendulkar stretches out for it, is playing it away from his body, the ball swings away, Tendulkar checks the shot, and hits a low catch to cover. His first single-figure score this year! What a time to do it
shot! short and wide, and he cuts it between backward point and cover-point
short and wide, Tendulkar looks to chase it, but is happy with the wide in the end
looks for the huge outswinger, and ends up being too straight and too full, and Tendulkar is not going to miss them, flicking it past square leg
shorter this time, and Tendulkar pounces on it, but finds cover-point
outswing, 140ks, Tendulkar shoulders arms
finishes a good over with the outswinger, no big swing, but straightens enough to make SRT play a watchful push wide of mid-off
inswing now, good stuff, swinging towards the off stump from wide outside off, SRT is watchful in pushing it to mid-on
gets this to straighten outside off, Tendulkar watchfully defends
beats SRT on the flick, appeals for lbw, but the angle is taking it down the leg side
and he gets the edge, and it goes wide of third slip! Pitches middle and off, and swings away, and the genuine edge goes safe
full, around off, slight shape away, left alone
short ball, gets a top edge. Game over. Mumbai through to the final
low full toss, hit down to long-on
goes for the yorker, wide down the leg side
slower ball, outside off, Kumble is beaten
now the quick yorker, and timber! These last few overs are reinforcing Mumabi have been too good on the night
split-finger slower ball, too good for Steyn, misses
slower ball, heaves and misses
full toss hit down to long-off for one
slower ball, heaves at it, gets a thick edge over short third
yorker, gets a single to long-off
full toss, mis-hit, sliced over extra cover, comes back for two
misses the yorker not by much, gets under it and lofts him four straight down the ground
full toss, he swings and misses
bowled him! Length ball, straight, Vinay Kumar backs away and swings and misses and out goes the middle stump
makes room to hit, but he doesn't get all of it, only a single
first length ball, VK hits it down to long-on
if ever Malinga was going to give a hittable delivery this was one, full toss down the leg side, and he gets only a leg-bye off it
full toss, backs away and hits to square leg
low full toss, hit to deep square leg for one
short ball into the ribs, gloved away to fine leg
low full toss, can't do much with it, just a single to long-on
low full toss, hit to long-off for one
another yorker, just a single to extra cover
yorker outside off, beats him
leading edge for one to point
full, middle and leg, gets one
misses the yorker by inches, hit powerfully down the ground, and Zaheer, captaining in SRT's absence, dives and saves
uff, this is unfair with more than two a ball to get, yorker, swinging in too, too good for VK, who manages a single nonetheless
near yorker, gets just a single to mid-off
another yorker, full and fast, leg stump, Taylor can't connect
yorker, on off stump, does well to save his toe. Shouldn't expect any runs off it
wide down the leg side
Oof, Bhajji has yorked him as a pacer would! Full, fast, straight, bounces on the popping crease, takes out the off stump
another full toss, again fails to connect cleanly, gets it one bounce to deep square leg
full toss, moves across, sweeps, mis0hit, but it has enough to clear square leg
worked away off the pads
moves across, drags this from outside off to long-on for one
another yorker fired in by Bhajji, hit back to him
slower ball, placed into the leg side for one
back of a length, just outside off, hit back to the bowler
and Pollard gets one more! Slower ball slogged away, Duminy at deep midwicket holds on to it head high, takes a step back, sees his inches from the rope, and then puts on the brakes very well
slower bouncer, hits him in the shoulder
full ball, hit to long-on for one
short ball, played with soft hands towards deep midwicket, looks like an easy two but Pollard sprints after it, slides, and keeps them to one. This is a man who was limping in his first over
fires in a yorker, only a single to midwicket
stays full, hit to midwicket for one
full and fast again, just a single to long-on
full, on the pads, fast, worked away for one
full on the pads, misses, gets a leg-bye
fired down the leg side, wide
yorks him with a full and wide one
full ball, from wide of the crease, hit down to long-on for one
slower ball, full outside off, driven for one
flicked away to deep midwicket for one

edged and taken! Pollard is all over Bangalore! And Kohli is not walking. Umpires consult with the third umpire, and the replays show it was caught about a foot off the ground. It was a slower ball that he looked to run to third man, but the pace variation did him in
slower ball, has to check the big shot, can't get the bunt past Pollard
bouncer, too short, and too high
short and wide, cut away, only a single to deep point
played with soft hands towards deep midwicket, and they come back for two
looks to make room and cut, Fernando follows him with a short one, but he manages to get it square enough of third man to come back for two
full ball, outside off, can't get under it, gets only a single to long-off
back of a length, over-steps, bunted for a single
inside edged, four, not fair for the bowler. Looks to whip it from outside off, and ends up placing it perfectly
looks to runs this down to third man for one, finds point
full toss on the pads, hits straight to fine leg
bunted to point for one, Nayar puts in the one-handed pick-up-and-throw but misses the stumps
beaten on the cut, not short enough for the shot
wide down the leg side

Dravid sacrifices his wicket for Taylor! This is punched to point, straight to the fielder, Dravid takes two non-committal steps, sees Taylor charging at him, and decides to give up his wicket. He is caught way short despite a wide throw, and Pollard dives to whip the bails off

slower ball, huge wicket! Pollard can do no wrong tonight! It's the slower ball, and he ends up dragging it much squarer than he would have wanted to hit, and Dhawan completes the pressure catch at deep square leg
slower ball, and Pollard dives across the pitch, saves one, gets the crowd involved
pulled away to deep midwicket for one
now for the delicacy! reverse-sweeps this from outside off, fine of short third man, four more
short, rocks back, pulls, wide of deep midwicket, six! Uthappa is in the building
fires in this yorker, squeezes under the huge back lift, but it is drifting down
looks to work it for one, turns the wrist early, gets a leading edge that falls just short of midwicket
nearly a yorker, but he has hit it so hard into the ground that it bounces over Bhajji and needs a full-length dive from Tiwary at long-off to keep it from four
flighted outside off, slog-swept clean as a whistle, and way over cow corner
Dravid will be cross here. Short and wide, with third man in the circle, and he late-cuts it and he finds the only fielder in the vicinity
length ball, on the pads, played with soft hands towards deep midwicket, thinks of two but decides against it
walks down the track, gets a slower ball, which he works away into the leg side
slower ball, driven on the up, wide enough of sweeper-cover to come back for two
slower ball, on the pads,  nurdled away for one
short and wide, and cut away for one, and Pollard is limping
this would have been wide had he not dabbed it, but he wouldn't have got four then. He managed to get this past short fine leg
pitched up on the pads, flicked to deep midwicket for one
flat on the pads, helped away for one
late-cuts this from in front of off stump for one
wide down the leg side, sharp turn. Uthappa wants a bye but is sent back
worked away off the pads for one

and he has him stumped! Sees his coming down, bowls it down the leg side, it turns across him, and even though Rayudu doesn't make a clean collection, KP is too far down the pitch to make it back in time. He dives back, but in vain. Mumbai crowd goes wild. It's actually good work from Rayudu who is so far down the leg side he has to dive to flick the bails off
worked away off the pads, square of deep fine leg, and they come back for two
looks to cut, there is no room, is beaten
comes down the track, this is a shorter delivery, gets a single to midwicket
again, back of a length, no room, punched to point
accurate delivery, back of a length, middle and off, hit to mid-on for a single
another near-yorker, hit to cover-point, bump-ball
starts off with a yorker, goes for a single
fast, short of driving length, on off stump, can't do much with it

clumsy work by Zaheer. Lovely drive on a near-yorker from Pietersen, between mid-off and extra cover. Zaheer gives the chase, doesn't know when to dive, doesn't dive at all, tumbles as he looks to field, and ends up giving one extra run
short and wide, and KP jumps into it, cutting it in front of square, but smack through the gap
slower ball, 122ks gets the mis-hit, but he got enough on it to clear mid-off. Only just
punched away, can't beat extra cover
worked away off the hips for one
walks down the pitch, Zak cuffs him up with a sharp short delivery, and then gives him the look
gets the outside half of the bat as he drives, one bounce to point
looks to drive, gets the inside half of the bat, comes back for two before fine leg can come around
shuffles across, gets inside the line, converts a middle-and-leg delivery into a wide one down the leg side, and glances it fine for four
looks to cut, doesn't make good connection, takes a single to point

edged! Tendulkar is deep at first slip. Tendulkar dives forward, claims the catch, Dravid doesn't believe him, stands his ground. Tendulkar's finger is bleeding. Third umpire takes him time. Tendulkar gets his fingers under it, but while he catches it, part of the ball touches the ground. Can't give it. It's called not-out, the Mumbai crowd boos. Tendulkar is off the ground
another beautiful legcutter, came length, but straighter, off and middle, holding its line, beats his drive across the line, which makes the delivery look even better
good bowling, more of a legcutter than an outswinger, back of a length, just outside off, moving away, KP withdraws from the shot after he has poked at it
lovely bowling, outswinger, back of a length outside off, Kallis follows and edges. Malinga is pumped up. Out comes KP, Kevin Pietersen
short and wide, cut away powerfully to third man for one
another outside edge for four, stretches to play at this one, and the outside edge goes along the ground and wide of slip
gets a leading edge on a length ball on off and middle, goes along the ground towards cover
full, half-volley even, hit straight back at Fernando
fuller, no room, short of driving length, and defended
this pull is more controlled, this time he rocks back early and pulls it in front of square. Not the best of connection, but clears the infield, and Nayar puts in a desperate dive but can't save four
back of a length, tucks him up, into the rubs, defended

dropped at deep fine leg by Dhawan, Kallis looks to full, this is not short enough, and a thick top edge seems to fly straight down Dhawan's throat, but at the last moment he is not under it and lets it burst through as he dives
short and wide, Kallis cuts it over the infield, looks only for elevation and not timing. Duminy gives good chase and keeps them down to two
ordinary delivery, down the leg side, and clipped away past deep fine leg. lovely timing
closer to the stumps, no room to swing the arms, and hit back to the bowler
edged, he just threw everything at it, and there was no way this edge was going to hand, flies long way over slip
beaten on the cut, extra bounce, Zaheer gives Dravid the look
short, cut away, gets a single to third man
short, angling across, left alone
